purpose: Teach: 買い手/忠告/転用/模範/必読/預かっ/コーディネート/休養

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様、当社製品の、買い手として、長年、お付き合い、本当に、感謝してる、これからも、大切に、していけ、絶対。
lines.en: Our valued clients — we've been grateful for your long partnership as a buyer of our products. That's something I want to keep treasuring, absolutely.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Formal register sits easily in his voice. Each clause lands with quiet weight. Slight pause before 'absolutely' — conviction, not performance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。先輩からの忠告、若手社員、しっかり、受け止めるよう、教育しております、本当に、社員、伸びてまいります、最近、特に。
lines.en: Yes. We make sure our younger staff take the senior advice to heart. I really do see our people growing lately, especially.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive tone. Measured pace. Slight upward inflection on 'especially' — pointing out progress with genuine pride, not flattery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 古い設備、転用できるもの、検討しろ、リサイクル、コスト削減、両立、目指せ、本当に、新時代の経営、必要だ。
lines.en: Look at that old equipment — study what we can repurpose. Aim for both recycling and cost-cutting. That's the kind of management this new era demands.
lines.style: Authoritative but not harsh. Each instruction lands cleanly. Measured tempo. The closing phrase slows slightly — emphasis on what's necessary, not what's optional.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。若手社員の、模範となる、先輩、増やしていきたいですね、社長、本当に、人材育成、徹底中です、最近、特に、力、入れて。
lines.en: Yes. I want to develop more senior staff who can model the way for our younger people. We're really focused on talent development right now — especially lately, we've been pouring energy into it.
lines.style: Earnest and engaged. Slight warmth beneath the formality. Builds momentum as he speaks about his team. The repetition ('really,' 'especially') feels like genuine emphasis, not filler.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の必読書、若手にも、読ませろ、私も、若い頃、本当に、勉強したぞ、必死で、これからの時代、知識、必要だ、絶対だ。
lines.en: Get those industry books in front of our younger staff. Make them read. I studied those desperately when I was their age, truly. Knowledge is going to be essential for the future. No getting around it.
lines.style: Direct and commanding. Opens firm. 'Desperately' carries personal weight — a rare glimpse of his own past effort. The closing emphatic phrases are unhurried but absolute.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様から、お預かったお品、慎重に、保管しております、社長、本当に、ご安心ください、徹底中、です、私たち、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. We handle customer deposits with the utmost care. Please be assured, President — we're thorough about it. It's something we really take seriously.
lines.style: Careful and reassuring. Measured delivery. Slight formality in 'utmost care' softens into genuine sincerity. The closing feels like a personal promise, not a corporate guarantee.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 広告のコーディネート、お洒落、第一に、こだわれ、当社のブランド、品格、保てるよう、社員、頑張れ、本当に、頼んだぞ、絶対。
lines.en: Make the advertising coordination polished and tasteful — that comes first. Make sure every staff member works to keep our brand's dignity intact. I'm counting on you all, truly.
lines.style: Exacting but not cold. Each directive is clear. Opens strong, then the closing phrase softens slightly — 'I'm counting on you' carries more weight than a typical order.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、休養、しっかり、取れるよう、有給休暇、取得、促進中です、健康、第一の、企業文化、目指しております、本当に、最近。
lines.en: Yes. We're actively promoting paid leave so our people can rest properly. We're aiming to build a company culture that puts health first — that's something we're really committed to right now.
lines.style: Warm closing note. Sincere about the effort. Measured pace. Slight lift on 'health first' — he means it. The final phrase trails slightly, like he's satisfied with this direction.
